newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Campbell Soup raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Campbell Soup raised.

text.p: -- BT Securities analyst John O'Neil said Thursday he raised his rating on Campbell Soup Co to buy from market perform.
-- He also raised his fiscal 1997 earnings estimate to $3.60 a share from $3.50, and set a 12-month price target for the stock in the low-$80s a share range.

-- This followed an announcement earlier today by Campbell of a plan it says will create earnings per share growth outpacing the food industry. The company said it would tender for up to $1.5 billion of its shares and divest several non-strategic businesses.
-- Campbell also is acquiring Erasco Group, Germany's leading canned soup company, from Grand Metropolitan PLC .
